title: Model adoption friction audit and prioritized field-probe plan
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Rapidly surface the top 5 friction factors that prevent mid-market customers from replacing hosted models with Dedicated/Private variants, then validate through 3 field probes.

Scope: 1) Competitive pricing & procurement friction 2) Latency/throughput mismatch for embedding-heavy features 3) Integration pain (SDKs, structured output, function calling parity) 4) Compliance/operational controls (audit/KMS, RBAC, VPC) 5) Trust signals (SLOs, provenance, regression risk).

Deliverables: a) Friction audit spreadsheet with scoring across 40 enterprise signals b) Prioritized probe plan (3 customer-facing experiments + 2 lab validations) c) Evidence pack (call transcripts, benchmark dashboards, PRD stubs) d) Recommended product bets with estimated engineering scope and KPIs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Audit completed with scores and a one-page prioritization matrix. 2) At least 2 field probes executed with writeups (hypothesis, outcome, impact). 3) Draft PRD for top recommendation reviewed by Eng + Security. 4) Kickoff for related experiments scheduled in Cycle 2025-W11.
comments: 2025-02-21 - Asha Patel: Kickoff completed with PM, Solutions Eng, and two SEs from runtime. Agreed scope and scoring dimensions. Assigned spreadsheet ownership to Diego.

2025-02-25 - Diego Morales: Initial audit pass uploaded (tab 1=signals, tab 2=scoring rules). Noted that pricing friction is bifurcated: commercial vs. technical (invoice/process vs token economics). Need to separate those in scoring.

2025-02-28 - Emily Chen (Solutions Eng): Ran embedding throughput microbenchmarks against a representative RAG workload; observed 2x tail-latency for Dedicated config vs hosted on short sequences. Lab validation flagged KV cache configuration mismatch.

2025-03-02 - Marcus Li (Security): Security controls checklist added; KMS integration path for Private highlighted as "medium effort" due to customer HSM requirements. Suggested adding a one-week spike for KMS PoC in probe plan.

2025-03-04 - Diego Morales: Prioritization draft complete. Top two probes recommended: (A) 'Procurement fast-path' with 3 customers to test simplified contract + reserved-capacity demo; (B) 'Latency tuning clinic' where runtime team pairs with customer infra to tune KV/caching and measure end-to-end SLOs. Filed GH issues for orchestration (link above).
risks: Field-probe recruitment may take >3 weeks for enterprise accounts, pushing schedule.
Benchmarks may not generalize; we will need to include at least two verticals (search RAG and embeddings vector search).
If probes show no measurable improvement with product changes, risk of wasting allocated eng cycles; mitigated by clear stop criteria.
next_steps: Secure commitments from 3 target customers for probe A (deadline 2025-03-11)
Spin up lab harness for 'Latency tuning clinic' with representative datasets (deadline 2025-03-07)
Create scoped PRD for top recommendation and get Eng + Security review (due 2025-03-14)
Assign one Solutions Eng as field lead and schedule probe kickoff calls
